A cache of derivative TypeCompositions keyed by the "revealed type".

detaileddescription.para: We assume that there will never be two instantiate-able classes with the same inception type, but different revealed type. The ClassComposition may hide (or mask) its original identity via the maskAs(TypeConstant) operation and later reveal it back.

Most of the time the revealed type is identical to the inception type so this map is going to be empty. One exception is the native types (e.g. Ref, Service), for which the inception type is defined by a NativeRebaseConstant class constant and the revealed type refers to the corresponding natural interface.
